mapper.insert: insert into it_purchase_request(no, catalog_id, item_name, category, applicant, applicant_id, dept, reason, expect_date, status) values(#{no}, #{catalogId}, #{itemName}, #{category}, #{applicant}, #{applicantId}, #{dept}, #{reason}, #{expectDate}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select:
select r.*, a.name as assetName, (select count(*) from it_missing_report m where m.status='PENDING' and m.requester_id = coalesce(r.applicant_id, (select case when count(*)=1 then min(u.id) end from sys_user u where u.name=r.applicant))) as pending_report_count from it_purchase_request r left join it_asset a on a.no = r.asset_no
and r.status = #{status} and r.no = #{no}
and (r.applicant_id = #{applicantId} or (r.applicant_id is null and r.applicant = #{applicant} and (select count(*) from sys_user u where u.name = r.applicant) = 1))
order by case r.status when 'PENDING' then 0 when 'APPROVED' then 1 when 'ORDERED' then 2 when 'PENDING_PICKUP' then 3 else 4 end, r.created_at desc limit 200
select count(*) from it_purchase_request where status = 'PENDING'
